paragraphs: Rabbi Elazar ben Pinchas, Jerusalem Talmud, Sotah 1:2: how long is intercourse? Elazar says, etc.; Yehoshua, ben Azzai, Akiva, Yehudah ben Beteira, Elazar ben Pinchas; Minyamin says.
